resource: Domain points of the highest revelation stage
allocation_impact: No allocation; revelation stages 1, 2 and 3 start at 250, 500 and 1000 points in one domain, and a domain holds at most 1000 points (nine slots).
boundary_tests: max=1000: 999 points give stage 2 and 1000 give stage 3
max+1: a domain cannot hold 1001 points (its capacities sum to 1000)
notes: WHEEL-0 §2 and §8 (thresholds 250/500/1000); test: character_wheel::tests::revelation_stages_follow_the_thresholds. Registered by WHEEL-W1.
